grammar.summary: 本课介绍圣伯纳德修道院，集中运用 which 引导的非限制性定语从句补充背景、now that 引导原因状语从句，以及 prefer...to...（更喜欢……而不喜欢）表达偏好；同时出现 be sent out 被动语态描述派狗救援。

points.title: 非限制性定语从句 (Non-restrictive Relative Clauses)
points.explanation: which 引导的非限制性定语从句用逗号与主句隔开，对先行词作补充说明，不可用 that 替换。本课用 which were first brought from Asia 补充说明狗的来历，用 who love the peace of mountains 补充说明年轻人。

examples.en: These friendly dogs, which were first brought from Asia, were used as watchdogs even in Roman times.
examples.cn: 那些最先从亚洲引进的狗，待人友好，早在罗马时代就给人当看门狗了。

examples.en: These young people, who love the peace of mountains, always receive a warm welcome at St. Bernard's monastery.
examples.cn: 这些热爱高山清静环境的年轻人每年都受到圣伯纳德道院的热烈欢迎。

points.title: now that 原因状语从句 (Reason clause with now that)
points.explanation: now that = since，引导原因状语从句，意为「既然、由于」，强调已发生的新情况带来的后果。本课用 Now that a tunnel has been built through the mountains 说明「既然修了隧道，山口就不那么危险了」。

examples.en: Now that a tunnel ahs been built through the mountains, the Pass is less dangerous
examples.cn: 如今由于山里开挖了隧道，翻越山口已不那么危险了。

points.title: prefer...to... 偏好 (prefer A to B)
points.explanation: prefer A to B 表示「比起 B 更喜欢 A」，A、B 多为名词或动名词。本课用 The monks prefer winter to summer 说明修道士「比起夏天更喜欢冬天」，因为冬天更清静。

examples.en: The monks prefer winter to summer of they have more privacy.
examples.cn: 修道士们喜欢冬天，而不太喜欢夏天。因为在冬天，他们可以更多地过无人打扰的生活。

exercises.q: These friendly dogs, ______ were first brought from Asia, were used as watchdogs even in Roman times.
______ a tunnel has been built through the mountains, the Pass is less dangerous.
The monks prefer winter ______ summer of they have more privacy.
用关系代词填空（先行词为「人」，非限制性从句）：These young people, ______ love the peace of mountains, always receive a warm welcome at St. Bernard's monastery.
